sources.name: p_schoolstaff_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> p_schoolstaff_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolstaff_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schoolstaff_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolstaff_s",  
  
    FixKinRelationship =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(Source, 12, 10, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"kin_relationship_id"}),  
  
    AddSchoolStaff =  
        Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table.AddColumn(FixKinRelationship, "schoolStaff", each "301220000"), {{"schoolStaff", type text}}),  
  
    DuplicateContact =  
        Table.DuplicateColumn(AddSchoolStaff, "contact_no", "contact_no_telephone"),  
  
    DuplicateStartDate =  
        Table.DuplicateColumn(DuplicateContact, "start_date", "start_date_import"),  
  
    SelectColumns =  
        Table.SelectColumns(  
            DuplicateStartDate,  
            {  
                "alternative_number","city_id","contact_no","contact_no_telephone",  
                "country_of_birth_id","date_of_birth","email","employee_type_id",  
                "first_name","gender","id","id_number",  
                "is_active","kin_contact_no","kin_email","kin_name",  
                "kin_relationship_id","last_name","middle_name","position_id","region_id","qualification_type_id","race_type_id","school_id",  
                "schoolStaff","start_date","start_date_import","street_address"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    RenameColumns =  
        Table.RenameColumns(  
            SelectColumns,  
            {  
                {"alternative_number", "tcbgrow_alternativenumber"},  
                {"city_id", "cog_city"},  
                {"contact_no", "mobilephone"},  
                {"contact_no_telephone", "telephone1"},  
                {"country_of_birth_id", "tcbgrow_countryofbirth"},  
                {"date_of_birth", "birthdate"},  
                {"email", "emailaddress1"},  
                {"employee_type_id", "tcbgrow_employeetype"},  
                {"first_name", "firstname"},  
                {"gender", "gendercode"},  
                {"id", "new_staff_id"},  
                {"id_number", "tcbgrow_idnumber"},  
                {"is_active", "statecode"},  
                {"kin_contact_no", "tcbgrow_nextofkincontactnumber"},  
                {"kin_email", "tcbgrow_nextofkinemail"},  
                {"kin_name", "tcbgrow_nextofkinname"},  
                {"kin_relationship_id", "tcbgrow_nextofkinrelationship"},  
                {"last_name", "lastname"},  
                {"middle_name", "middlename"},  
                {"position_id", "tcbgrow_staffrole"},  
                {"region_id", "cog_region"},  
                {"qualification_type_id", "tcbgrow_qualification"},  
                {"race_type_id", "tcbgrow_race"},  
                {"school_id", "tcbgrow_schoolappid"},  
                {"schoolStaff", "tcbgrow_schoolstaff"},  
                {"start_date", "new_start_date"},  
                {"start_date_import", "tcbgrow_startdate"},  
                {"street_address", "tcbgrow_address1"}  
            }  
        ),
  #"Replaced value" = Table.ReplaceValue(RenameColumns, null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"tcbgrow_alternativenumber", "mobilephone", "telephone1", "emailaddress1", "firstname", "gendercode", "new_staff_id", "tcbgrow_idnumber", "tcbgrow_nextofkincontactnumber", "tcbgrow_nextofkinemail", "tcbgrow_nextofkinname", "lastname", "middlename", "tcbgrow_schoolstaff", "tcbgrow_address1"}),
#"Calculated date" =  
    Table.TransformColumns(  
        #"Replaced value",  
        {  
            {"tcbgrow_startdate", each Date.From(_), type nullable date},  
            {"new_start_date", each Date.From(_), type nullable date},  
            {"birthdate", each Date.From(_), type nullable date}  
        }  
    )    
  
in  
    #"Calculated date";
